row.evidence: DatoCMS's plan comparison shows 'SCIM provisioning via IdP' and Single Sign-On only on Enterprise ('Contact us'), not on Professional (from €149/month), and its Okta guide says 'Single Sign-On is only available for Enterprise plans.'
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM and SAML SSO are Enterprise-only (Contact Sales). Pricing is listed only in EUR: Professional is a flat €149/month billed annually (€199 monthly) with 10 collaborators per project, extra collaborators €9/mo; no per-user price. June's '~$499+/mo' Enterprise figure has no first-party source and was dropped. SCIM base URL https://sso.datocms.com/scim with a bearer token generated under Settings > Single Sign-On > SCIM Settings; Okta and OneLogin catalogue apps provision; Entra uses a custom (non-gallery) app pointed at the SCIM URL. Deprovisioning deactivates the SSO user (cannot log in). SAML JIT supported. Audit Log API is Enterprise-only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free plan has the Professional features with lower limits; SSO/SCIM rows show Enterprise only.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Flat project price in EUR including 10 collaborators; extra collaborators €9/mo each.

auth.token_source: Project Settings > Single Sign-On > Settings > SCIM Settings > Generate API Token

endpoints.notes: SCIM endpoints are not listed individually; Users and Groups are implied by the documented user create and group push flows against the SCIM base URL.

operations.notes: read inferred from Okta 'Import Users'. Update is documented without saying PUT or PATCH. Groups pushed from Okta can be deleted via SCIM.

deprovision.data_retained: SSO user is marked inactive and cannot log in; the record remains (it can be reactivated from Okta).

custom.how: Entra guide: any attribute other than the recognised ones is ignored (the recognised list is shown only as an image).

attributes.notes: The SCIM attribute table is an image in the Entra guide; the SSO User object exposes username (email), external_id, first_name, last_name, is_active, groups and role.

roles.how: IdP groups pushed via SCIM become DatoCMS SSO groups; an admin maps each group to a role, the first group in priority order wins, and users in no group get the default role from SSO settings.

limitations.text: OneLogin cannot push its groups to DatoCMS; groups must be created in DatoCMS (Sync with roles) and imported into OneLogin.
Groups imported from DatoCMS into Okta cannot be changed or deleted in Okta.
Known Okta issue: removing a user from their only group deactivates the user but leaves them in the group.

auth.notes: Bearer API token per project; token permissions are defined by roles (e.g. can_manage_users, can_manage_sso, can_access_audit_log) rather than OAuth scopes.

capabilities.notes: Collaborators are added by invitation, not created directly. Update a collaborator takes is_active and role. SSO groups (created by the IdP) can be updated or deleted, not created, via the CMA.

endpoints.purpose: Sync SSO provider groups to DatoCMS roles

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook entity_type enum includes sso_user; the event names for it are not listed on the page.

rate_limits.text: Content Management API: 60 requests every 3 seconds; 429 with x-ratelimit-reset.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked (read from the --checked classes in page markup); SWA is not checked.

entra.notes: DatoCMS's Entra guide uses 'Create your own application' (non-gallery) with the generic SCIM tenant URL; no Entra gallery tutorial found.

onelogin.notes: From DatoCMS's own OneLogin guide (search for DatoCMS in the OneLogin app catalogue); OneLogin's connector page not loaded.

searched: web search: DatoCMS Microsoft Entra gallery / JumpCloud
open_questions: SCIM version is not stated (base URL https://sso.datocms.com/scim has no version segment).
SCIM attribute list in the Entra guide is an image; exact SCIM attribute names are not available as text.
Docs do not say whether a deactivated SSO user frees a collaborator seat or whether active sessions end.
Whether SCIM DELETE /Users is supported is not documented.
SCIM filtering, pagination, ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas endpoints and SCIM token expiry are not documented.
Whether SSO must be configured before SCIM is not stated explicitly (both live in the same SSO settings).
No Microsoft Entra gallery app, Google Workspace or JumpCloud catalogue entry was found or checked.
Enterprise price and seat minimum are not public.
